title: deyeuxia scabra
intro: Deyeuxia scabra, commonly known as the rough grass, is a type of plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to alleviate conditions like fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Deyeuxia scabra include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation, making it a potential natural remedy for insomnia and other sleep disorders. The bioactive constituents of Deyeuxia scabra include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic actions.
